--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,36 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for name, arr in [('logp_with_result', logp_with_result), ('logp_call_only', logp_call_only), ('logp_no_call', logp_no_call)]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(name + ' must be a numpy array')
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(name + ' must be a 2D matrix')
+        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
+            raise ValueError(name + ' must not be empty')
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(name + ' contains non-finite values')
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(name + ' contains positive values')
+    # Check shapes match
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError('Input matrices must have the same shape')
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must not be a boolean')
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be finite')
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be nonnegative')
+    
+    # Compute per-step margins: improvement over best baseline
+    baseline = np.maximum(logp_call_only, logp_no_call)
+    margins = logp_with_result - baseline  # shape (n, h)
+    
+    # Aggregate over horizon: mean
+    per_candidate_margins = margins.mean(axis=1)  # shape (n,)
+    
+    keep = per_candidate_margins > tau_filter
+    
+    return keep, per_candidate_margins
